value: Build trust by consistently demonstrating reliability, honesty, and competence.
content: Build trust by consistently demonstrating reliability, honesty, and competence.

value: Keep promises – Follow through on commitments, even small ones.
content: Keep promises – Follow through on commitments, even small ones.

value: *Example:* If you say you’ll deliver a report by Friday, submit it on Friday.
content: *Example:* If you say you’ll deliver a report by Friday, submit it on Friday.

value: Be honest – Share accurate information, admit mistakes, and avoid deception.
content: Be honest – Share accurate information, admit mistakes, and avoid deception.

value: *Example:* If a project will be delayed, inform stakeholders immediately and explain why.
content: *Example:* If a project will be delayed, inform stakeholders immediately and explain why.

value: Show competence – Demonstrate the skills and knowledge needed for the task.
content: Show competence – Demonstrate the skills and knowledge needed for the task.

value: *Example:* Provide well‑researched advice or complete work efficiently.
content: *Example:* Provide well‑researched advice or complete work efficiently.

value: Communicate clearly – Keep others informed about progress, obstacles, and decisions.
content: Communicate clearly – Keep others informed about progress, obstacles, and decisions.

value: *Example:* Send regular status updates rather than leaving people guessing.
content: *Example:* Send regular status updates rather than leaving people guessing.

value: Be consistent – Act in the same manner over time; avoid erratic or contradictory behavior.
content: Be consistent – Act in the same manner over time; avoid erratic or contradictory behavior.

value: *Example:* Treat all team members with the same respect and fairness.
content: *Example:* Treat all team members with the same respect and fairness.

value: Show empathy – Understand others’ perspectives and respond with compassion.
content: Show empathy – Understand others’ perspectives and respond with compassion.

value: *Example:* Acknowledge a colleague’s workload stress and offer help.
content: *Example:* Acknowledge a colleague’s workload stress and offer help.

value: Maintain confidentiality – Protect private information and respect boundaries.
content: Maintain confidentiality – Protect private information and respect boundaries.

value: *Example:* Do not share a coworker’s personal issue without permission.
content: *Example:* Do not share a coworker’s personal issue without permission.

value: Admit and correct errors – Own mistakes, apologize, and take steps to fix them.
content: Admit and correct errors – Own mistakes, apologize, and take steps to fix them.

value: *Example:* If a calculation is wrong, correct it and inform anyone affected.
content: *Example:* If a calculation is wrong, correct it and inform anyone affected.

value: Demonstrate integrity – Align actions with stated values and principles.
content: Demonstrate integrity – Align actions with stated values and principles.

value: *Example:* If you value punctuality, never be late.
content: *Example:* If you value punctuality, never be late.

value: Seek feedback – Regularly ask for input on your behavior and adjust accordingly.
content: Seek feedback – Regularly ask for input on your behavior and adjust accordingly.

value: *Example:* Conduct a brief check‑in after a meeting to see if your communication was effective.
content: *Example:* Conduct a brief check‑in after a meeting to see if your communication was effective.

value: By repeatedly applying these behaviors, trust is built incrementally and becomes a stable part of the relationship.
content: By repeatedly applying these behaviors, trust is built incrementally and becomes a stable part of the relationship.
